casual1.scene: Terracotta planters and a brass gear-shaped wind chime sit along the balcony rail in late-afternoon light.
casual1.outfit: An emerald fantasy stage outfit: an off-shoulder cropped velvet bodice with a separate flowing skirt, leaving shoulders and the midriff bare.

why.scene: 발코니 선택에 없는 화분 소재·시간대·주변 원작 모티프를 보충한다.
why.outfit: 자동 costume은 옷 구조가 없어 skirt와 오프숄더·크롭 조합을 구체화한다.

casual2.scene: The rooftop party is in full swing beside a narrow plunge pool, with warm bulbs reflected in blue water and a little gear-shaped table ornament.
casual2.outfit: A cobalt-blue bandeau bikini with a straight strapless top and high-cut bottoms, leaving the midriff bare; a small gear earring supplies the single accessory motif.

why.scene: 루프톱 파티의 수영복 상황을 풀 데크와 조명 반사로 설명하고 주변 오브젝트를 정한다.
why.outfit: 선택된 bandeau bikini에 high-cut leg와 bare midriff, 원작과 다른 색을 보충한다.

casual3.scene: A camp stove and folding table stand beneath canvas awnings beside berry baskets; a three-gear brass timer and cog-shaped trivet sit near the pot in late-morning light.
casual3.outfit: Glamorous tailored workwear: an off-shoulder peach silk blouse and a fitted cropped ivory vest, paired with a high-waisted chocolate pencil skirt; the shoulders and a narrow strip of midriff remain bare.

why.scene: 선택된 야영 조리장의 도구 배치·시간대·주변 톱니 모티프를 보충한다.
why.outfit: vest·blouse·pencil skirt 종류를 유지하며 새 예약 off-shoulder neckline과 cropped hem을 기존 비대칭 조끼와 다른 실루엣으로 구체화한다.
